verdicts.reason: Both break the logo in the same way: the sun icon is shrunk onto the SOLSTICE wordmark so it reads 'SOLST CE', and both leave the right third as dead space with only the decorative circles. A's headline is strong, but its subline is set so small that it is unreadable at banner size, and the text block sits high. B's subline is noticeably larger and readable, the headline/subline pair is better centred against the product box, and the headline still dominates, so B is the less bad of the two (its box does crowd the bottom edge slightly).
